title: flower
description: The reproductive organ of an angiosperm: a modified shoot bearing stamens (producing pollen) and/or carpels (enclosing ovules). The site of pollination and double fertilization, from which fruit and seed are set. Generated by the plant's reproducing.

modified-shoot.description: a determinate shoot whose organs are reproductive

carpels.description: megasporophylls enclosing ovules (the angiosperm innovation: the enclosed seed)
